dedupe_keys.name: public transport network and ridership data for 48 european metropolitan areas

description: Public transport network and ridership data for 48 European metropolitan areas is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Jesper Bláfoss Ingvardson. Dataset of public transport network characteristics for 48 European metropolitan areas. Includes network characteristics and ridership split on public transport modes as well as various economic and urban characteristic collected from multiple data sources, which also are stated in the dataset. Coverage: continental; the metadata date the deposit to 2018. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support transport-network, traffic and mobility studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
